page_note: Page is 100% damaged but the visible content is a first-person missionary narrative by Mani: "I came from the land of Persia", "I went up", "I proclaimed this knowledge", "I separated life from death", "I came to the land of Babylon, the city of the Assyrians", "I walked within...", "I spoke in the truth", "I proclaimed in her the word of life". Content includes references to satraps, governors, caesars, kings, Persia, Babylon, Assyrians, demons, humanity under evil. This is hagiographic-biographical material about the Apostle's mission — entirely editorial frame. NO cosmological substrate teaching is present on this page. The dialogue frame is in narrative-autobiographical mode rather than Q&A mode, but it belongs to the same editorial layer that constructs Mani as Apostle.
